name: marshal
description: Marshal in Claude Code: delegate work to Marshal runs, watch your fleet of deputy runs in a live pane and answer what needs you, and inspect the space you work in.

url.title: Marshal MCP address
url.description: Your Marshal MCP address, as the Marshal web app shows it under Connect an agent, for example https://marshal.example.com/mcp. The plugin connects Claude Code to it; run /mcp once to sign in. Leave it empty if you added Marshal with claude mcp add.

server.title: Marshal server
server.description: Which connected Marshal MCP server the panes read, by its /mcp name. Empty uses the one from the address above, else the first connected Marshal server.

fleet.title: Fleet pane
fleet.description: auto opens the fleet pane when a session starts on a wide terminal; command opens it only with /marshal-fleet; off turns the fleet pane, its status line and toasts off.

space.title: Space inspector
space.description: Inside a Marshal space: auto opens the inspector when a session starts on a wide terminal; command opens it only with /marshal-space; off turns it off.

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the panes read Marshal. Lower is fresher and costs more calls.

notify.title: Notify on new asks
notify.description: Raise a desktop notification when a run asks you something, as well as a toast.
